title: Conditional κ = 7.14026746429965·10⁻⁴ on #249's word: 890 kernel families, #263/#270 retimings, #273's target-prefix squares and 126 cleanup sandwiches (#271), composed (+0.42% over #259; above #271/#275)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.14026746429965·10⁻⁴ on #249's word: 890 kernel families, #263/#270 retimings, #273's target-prefix squares and 126 cleanup sandwiches (#271), composed (+0.42% over #259; above #271/#275)

One self-contained package, `research/multicut-kernel-composition/` (renamed from the first version of this PR), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 142805349285993/(2·10¹⁷) = 7.14026746429965·10⁻⁴** on the pinned #249 word: +0.4216% over #259, +0.0510% over #271's 7.13662156·10⁻⁴ (99 sandwiches on #272) and +0.0472% over #275's 7.13690108·10⁻⁴, the best rungs on this word before it. Before the sandwich stage, with #259's seven native checkers alone: κ = 7.12005174354669·10⁻⁴ (+5.6·10⁻⁸ over #273). **#276's new bit word (gen4, 7.2287·10⁻⁴) stands above every rung on #249's word, this one included**; the levers composed here will have to be re-derived on that word.

## Result

| stage (each on the previous word) | families / entrance rank | normalized stock W | κ |
|---|---|---|---|
| #259 | 518 / 1,344 | 173,435 | 7.11029386054035·10⁻⁴ |
| kernel families: early-cut twins, headroom, 54 shared-donor families | **890 / 1,719** | 173,310 | 7.11462218·10⁻⁴ |
| + #263's 25 descent gates + #270's 29 plateau blocks | 890 / 1,719 | 173,310 | 7.11482139228173·10⁻⁴ |
| + #273's 209 target-prefix squares (native stage) — seven native checkers' word | 890 / 1,719 | 173,310 | **7.12005174354669·10⁻⁴** |
| + 126 cleanup sandwiches (#271), after swapping the pivot role in 83 pair families | 890 / 1,719 | **172,470** | **7.14026746429965·10⁻⁴** |

Four levers by five authors on one transcript. Three rounds of kernel families at #259's earliest cut (record 676,559, the last initial compensation read): **333 twin pairs** disjoint from #259's helpers (319 on lines eᵢ − eⱼ, admitted by #259's generic chart audit and excluded by #254's `norm == 4` rule), **32 more** from a census of every response class at twelve cuts (nothing at any later cut, no net-positive XOR triple), and **54 shared-donor families** — a new pivot whose twin partner already serves another family as donor, lifted once on a nested entrance chain (the idea of #270's 24 reuse pairs and #267's chronological donor sharing; #259's transform admits it as is, since it only requires pivots to be unique and never donors), with 26 plain pairs dissolved where a shared-donor family is strictly better. Then **#263's 25 descent gates** and **#270's 29 plateau blocks (57 ADDs)**, both selections rebound to this transcript by #270's scalar-core alignment (every ADD/COPY/ERASE outside the kernel categories identical). Then eumemic's target-prefix compression as rohanarun's native stage (#273, verbatim; its 209 squares rebound by post-cut scalar alignment, recomputing every F₂ dependency from the actual word: +5.2·10⁻⁷), and evmckinney9's cleanup sandwiches (#271): on this word 83 two-member kernel families have the sandwich shape on the member that was not the pivot, so the pivot role is moved there (cost-neutral for the kernel transform: identical histogram, rank, reads and native receipts), which raises the admissible sandwiches from 45 to 128; 126 are retired (the bank re-tiling needs a multiple of three), +2.0·10⁻⁶ — the largest single lever here, and the reason #271's 99 on #272's word was the previous best. Every family, retiming, square and sandwich is admitted by the package's exact pricer on the whole word; the deficit 35,200 per replica is invariant, so the gain is in the log-weighted rank mass (and, for the sandwiches, the stock).

## Argument and checks (PROOF.md)

#259's mechanism untouched: the pivot starts at the common entrance (its initial reads deleted), the donor moves there and absorbs it, the inverse is paid at the full frame; the omitted response cancels against the induced one because the responses coincide. Checked on the native word (sha eaff3c98…, behind sha gates cohort 4458dce8… → descent a6d793d7… → plateau a1cf58b3…): all-column F₂ replay forward and inverse (890 pivots, 60,520 reads removed, 2,286 gates, raw mass 434,177 → 432,458; omitted-Q / omitted-Q⁻¹ controls fail nontrivially), the descent, plateau and target-prefix stages with their audits (operand source spans, added frames with nondegenerate Grams, both all-column replays of the compression with the omitted-setup control), chronological legality (1,903 helpers, 0 owner/donor intersections, 24 COPY/ERASE windows), prefix kernels (4 cuts, 1,566,400 target-kernel equalities), bank review (919 exact charts ≤ 262 factors, 3,317,400 assignments), the 23,627 five-stage F₂ columns, the exact price (47/47 constraints, adjacent grid rejected, pinned baseline regression exact) and the finite invoice. The sandwich word (sha 9556bfe3…) is certified as #271 certifies it, because #259's native bank review and price driver assume every helper ends at the full frame: native legality with the stage's final frames, native prefix and five-stage columns on the new word, exact SymPy endpoint charts (126 rank-3 partial swaps) with the bank re-tiling, the unchanged price engine through #271's histogram wrapper (which first reproduces the native price bit for bit), and the native finite invoice; `RESULT.json` and the certificate carry both κ values.

## Verify

    sudo apt-get install -y g++ libboost-dev
    python -m pip install -r research/multicut-kernel-composition/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -I research/multicut-kernel-composition/verify.py --output /tmp/mkc-replay   # about 4 minutes; fresh directory outside the package

#259's verifier with the stages inserted (02b descent, 02c–02e plateau, 02f target prefix, the seven native checkers, then 09–17 the sandwich stage and its checks), each gated by the sha256 of the transcript it consumes; prints `PASS: kappa = 0.000714026746429965 (seven native checkers alone, before the sandwich stage: 0.000712005174354669)`. Passes locally (macOS/clang) and on Linux/g++ with identical transcript hashes (native word eaff3c98…, sandwich word 9556bfe3…); the workflow runs it on Ubuntu with Python 3.11 and 3.13.

## Scope and limits

* Same conditional status as #249/#254/#259 (finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses; no Lean certificate). κ is bit-bound; the complex supplier of this lineage is at 7.5474·10⁻⁴ five-stage (#256, Lean-checked).
* Not composed: #272's frame-filtered collective kernels (925 families), #275's zero-frame target restores, the fixed-prime refinement of #261/#265 (+4·10⁻¹²), the two sandwiches beyond 126 (mod-3 rule). #276's gen4 word is a different bit word; none of these levers has been re-derived on it yet.
* Diff against #259's package (`discovery/README.md`): the frozen selection, the retiming stages and their rebound selections (verbatim from #263 and #270), #273's target-prefix stage (verbatim) with its rebound selection, #271's sandwich mechanism ported as three files, `verify.py` with the stages and sha gates, regenerated receipts, and two platform fixes (`std::stable_sort` on the gauge order — the tie order of `std::sort` differs between libstdc++ and libc++ and changes the transcript's sha256 — and the compiler-dependent memo-cache counter `containment_pairs_checked` dropped from the compared receipt fields). #259's own README/PROOF are kept as `README-PR259.md`, `PROOF-PR259.md`.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md` and `vendor/UPSTREAM-NOTICE.md`. The mechanism, chart audit, checkers and pricer are Dugongue's (#254, #259; donor sharing #267); the descent retiming stage and its 25 gates, and the native target-prefix stage with its 209 squares, are rohanarun's (#263, #273); the target-prefix compression is eumemic's idea (#268); the plateau retiming stage, the 24 reuse pairs, the two e = 2 planes and the selection rebinding are utcorvusvolat-dotcom's (#270); the cleanup-sandwich rewrite, its endpoint charts, re-tiling and price wrapper are evmckinney9's (#271); the word is eumemic's #249 (on #244/#251, #210's helper, #168's modules) in the five-stage layout of hcg890 (#234) and rohanarun (#237/#209). This package contributes the censuses, the 387 families, the pivot-role swap that exposes the sandwiches, the composition of the four levers in one verifier, the receipts and the discovery scripts.
